text:
Support-Alex: Customer on prod (org: acme-inc) reporting EventStream stops after ~7 events in Safari only. Chrome/Firefox fine. Customer says they see connection open in Network tab but no further events. Escalating — attaching headers and quick repro below.

Morgan: Can you paste the full response headers and curl -N output? Safari has known buffering quirks with gzip + CDN rewriting.

Support-Alex: Pasting headers we captured from the logged request:
```
HTTP/2 200
content-type: text/event-stream; charset=utf-8
transfer-encoding: chunked
content-encoding: gzip
cache-control: public, max-age=0
vary: Authorization
server: cloudflare
cf-ray: 82bcd12345
```
And a trimmed SSE payload we logged (note the comment padding we send):
```
data: {"id":1,"text":"started"}

:data keepalive

data: {"id":2,"text":"step1"}

data: {"id":3,"text":"step2"}

```
In prod we see first 3 events in Safari then nothing. `curl -N` against the same URL returns continuous events (no stall).

Emily: Interesting — customer on Cloudflare Pro. Do they have Auto Minify / Rocket Loader on? Those can mangle payloads. Also Cloudflare sometimes recompresses and can remove very small comment-only chunks.

Morgan: Repro steps I ran locally: `curl -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -N https://staging.redwood.ai/stream/abc` -> works. Safari 15 on macOS: loads first events then stalls, but connection remains ESTABLISHED. Devtools shows no new lines arriving. This matches buffering at the browser side (Safari defers stream until internal buffer threshold is hit when gzip/HTTP2 framing happens).

Support-Alex: Customer toggled Auto Minify off in Cloudflare and reported immediate improvement in staging — stream stayed live. So Auto Minify was removing our `:keepalive` comment lines.

Morgan: Root cause hypothesis: CDN/edge is doing transformations (minify/recompress) and coalescing or dropping comment-only chunks used as padding. Safari relies on flush semantics; without padding Safari doesn't expose events until a larger buffered block is ready. Mitigations:
- Ensure server sets `Cache-Control: no-transform` so intermediaries don't rewrite payloads.
- Set `X-Accel-Buffering: no` / `Surrogate-Control` to disable buffering at reverse proxies when present.
- Avoid relying on comment-only single-line padding; send a larger minimal padding block (e.g., 2KB of spaces or an ASCII comment chunk) periodically.

Emily: Quick fix snippet to tell customers: 
```
res.setHeader('Content-Type','text/event-stream; charset=utf-8')
res.setHeader('Cache-Control','no-transform, no-cache')
res.setHeader('X-Accel-Buffering','no')
// send initial padding
res.write(':'.padEnd(2048, ' ') + '

')
```
Also recommend disabling Auto Minify / HTML/JS/CSS minify for the SSE host on Cloudflare.

sre-bot: Created INC-3421, assigned to eng-runtime and edge team.

Support-Alex: Customer applied `no-transform` and disabled Auto Minify. They reported 24h stable stream in Safari. They want a permanent recommendation in our KB and a runtime-level guard so hosted API responses include `no-transform` for event-stream.

Morgan: I'll open a PR to set `Cache-Control: no-transform` for our streaming endpoints and add runtime padding as a fallback. Also adding detection in logs for `Content-Encoding: gzip` + `Vary`/`Cache-Control` to flag possible transformations.

Emily: I'll draft a short KB article for Support with quick repro, the curl commands to ask customers to run (`curl -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -N <url>`), and the short server snippet.

Support-Alex: Customer happy for now, leaving Auto Minify off. Adding emoji reaction :thumbsup:.

Morgan: Note for follow-up: test behaviour with HTTP/2 + h2 proxying and with Cloudflare `mirage`/`polish` features — these have caused similar issues historically.
